notes.title: Episode 2 Is Out Now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235755/87abf05d6d2ac8b60db6a75002b2e78f9565e1cb.jpg[/img]

Hey! [b]Episode 2 is finally here![/b]

If you already own the game, the update will install automatically—no extra steps needed.

If you saved after finishing Episode 1, just load your save and continue. If not, check the auto-saves page—your progress might still be there.

Don't forget to share your thoughts after playing—I’d love to hear your feedback!

[i]Enjoy, and thanks for your support![/i]
